run_redis_set_foo: run a python script that connects to Redis and sets key 'foo' to value 'bar'
review_redis_connection: review the python script that creates a Redis client and sets a key-value pair
summarize_redis_script: summarize the python script that uses redis.Redis to store a simple key-value entry
refactor_redis_set: refactor the python script to parameterize the Redis key and value instead of hardcoding them
test_redis_set: test the python script that sets a Redis key 'foo' to 'bar' and verify the value
